Class Subject<T>

java.lang.Object
io.reactivex.rxjava4.core.Observable<T>
io.reactivex.rxjava4.subjects.Subject<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the item value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableSource<T>, Observer<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncSubject, BehaviorSubject, PublishSubject, ReplaySubject, UnicastSubject
public abstract class Subject<T> extends Observable<T> implements Observer<T>
Represents an Observer and an Observable at the same time, allowing multicasting events from a single source to multiple child Observers.

All methods except the Observer.onSubscribe(io.reactivex.rxjava4.disposables.Disposable), Observer.onNext(Object), Observer.onError(Throwable) and Observer.onComplete() are thread-safe. Use toSerialized() to make these methods thread-safe as well.
